description: Substation Sites List is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. A list of all substations operated by Northern Powergrid, with transformer ratings, customer numbers, location data and other site metadata, now updated for 2026. Related Feature Pages N/A Glossary of terms Our Glossary dataset provides definitions for various terms and acronyms found throughout our data. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Network. Its keywords are Low Voltage (LV), High Voltage (HV), Extra High Voltage (EHV), Transformer, EHV Substation Data, Methodology. The portal shows 2026-07-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
